findings.description: Codex lane call to codex exec timed out twice (120s baseline, 300s retry). Unable to obtain second opinion from gpt-5.6-terra. This is a platform issue, not a task issue.
findings.evidence: Codex exec commands (two attempts with timeouts) failed to return a verdict. Retry limit reached per courier protocol. The checker-of-record (Claude haiku) returned PASS on this clause; the blocked second opinion is comparison data only and does not gate the task.
